integrity: Proof supplied; embedded checker checks derivation equations, parameter dimensions, sample rank determinants, and exhaustive leading matrices over fields of sizes 2, 3, 4, and 5.
scientific_limitations: Exact count for radical-preserving ordinary derivations of the 3-generator Grassmann algebra; not all ranks, not all generator numbers, and in characteristic two not unrestricted derivations. General characteristic-polynomial formulas could yield indirect alternative derivations; publication priority is not certified. Finite checks do not certify infinitely many fields.
title: Exact maximal-radical-rank derivation census of the three-generator Grassmann algebra
